footnote_text: Represents 4,412 Ordinary Shares, par value $0.01 per share, of the Issuer, which were issued upon vesting of Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") on July 31, 2026, under the Issuer's 2025 Omnibus Equity Incentive Plan (the "Plan") pursuant to Rule 16b-3, of which a total of 30,880 have vested. || RSUs convert into Ordinary Shares on a one-for-one basis.
